clippings.speaker: Steven Spielberg
clippings.quote: Harrison brought that entire tapestry to the entire part. That transformed the movie for me.
clippings.title: On the Scene: Raiders of the Lost Ark 30th Anniversary
clippings.context: At the 30th-anniversary Q&A after a Raiders screening, Spielberg explains that Ford's insistence on Indy showing fear was Ford's idea.

clippings.speaker: Steven Spielberg
clippings.quote: I wasn't cross, I was crushed, but then Sam Neill came available and he's Alan Grant. It now belongs to him.
clippings.title: Harrison Ford turned down Alan Grant, and Spielberg waited 30 years to reveal it
clippings.context: Spielberg, on a podcast with Josh Horowitz, on how Ford turned down the Alan Grant role in Jurassic Park.

clippings.speaker: Steven Spielberg
clippings.quote: I sensed an exceptionally strong mind and a very smart person, and called on him time and time again.
clippings.title: Steven Spielberg Gave Harrison Ford An Unusual Amount Of Creative Control Over Raiders Of The Lost Ark
clippings.context: Spielberg on why he gave Ford a large say in Raiders; quoted secondhand from Lee Pfeiffer and Michael Lewis's book via a SlashFilm article (the date given is the article's, the book's date is unknown).

clippings.speaker: Harrison Ford
clippings.quote: We can feel his spirit, and his energy, and his focus, and his filmmaking skill.
clippings.film: Indiana Jones and the Dial of Destiny
clippings.title: We Talk To Harrison Ford About How Steven Spielberg Was Involved In Indiana Jones And The Dial Of Destiny & More
clippings.context: Ford, in an interview ahead of Dial of Destiny, on Spielberg's role as executive producer even though he did not direct.

clippings.speaker: Harrison Ford
clippings.quote: Steven was very fast, very fluid, it was effortless to make the film.
clippings.title: On the Scene: Raiders of the Lost Ark 30th Anniversary
clippings.context: At the 30th-anniversary Q&A after a Raiders screening, Ford describes shooting the film with Spielberg.

clippings.speaker: Harrison Ford
clippings.quote: I went over to Steven Spielberg’s house — never met Steven Spielberg before — I guess about an hour later I had the job.
clippings.title: 'Indiana Jones' star Harrison Ford reveals which actor was originally offered lead role
clippings.context: Ford recalls how he got the Indiana Jones job after George Lucas sent him to meet Spielberg; quoted in a 2023 Fox News article, original interview not identified.

notes: Several quotes were checked through a summarizing fetch that capped excerpts at 125 characters, so verify exact wording before merge. Empire pages and an MTV transcript were blocked or empty, and the Variety Ford interview was only reached via Jedi News. Spielberg-side material is thinner than Ford-side.
